title: Chisei
body:
Syntax: perform chisei

Description: Temporarily increases maximum Chakra and Genjutsu accuracy for 60 seconds. Gain temporary maximum Chakra and +12 accuracy for Genjutsu attacks for 60 seconds. Usable with any chakra nature. Unlocks at level 40. Costs 30 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 15 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
